queries.query: Huangshan China cadastral parcel map official GIS land registry
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Huangshan Natural Resources and Planning Bureau material describing cadastral investigation, a citywide cadastral database, and real-estate registration responsibilities. It also identified an official Huangshan GIS ArcGIS REST service listing, but no usable feature response was obtained during this attempt.

queries.query: 黄山市 不动产登记 地籍图 宗地图 官方 GIS
queries.result: 官方检索找到黄山市自然资源和规划局关于地籍调查机制、全生命周期地籍数据库和不动产登记机构的说明，也找到黄山市标准地图服务和官方 ArcGIS REST 服务目录；未取得可匿名查询的安全宗地编号加完整宗地面响应。

registryEvidence: The official Huangshan Natural Resources and Planning Bureau identifies local natural-resources and real-estate registration responsibilities and describes a full-territory cadastral database. This establishes a local custodian and cadastral system, not anonymous public parcel-geometry access.
sourceScope: Huangshan prefecture-level city, Anhui, China; local custodial evidence and a public municipal GIS service directory were inspected. Citywide open parcel geometry coverage was not established.
